title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Humjoli
desc: Gopaldas marries heiress Roopa to get rich. His greed spirals out of control when he plots her murder to inherit her wealth.

title: Madgaon Express
desc: Childhood friends Dodo, Ayush, and Pinku head to Goa for fun, but a chain of impulsive choices, wild detours, and hilariously bad decisions turns their dream trip into total chaos.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary reunites with a British officer he once shared a bond with. Together, they set aside differences to fight despotic rulers, forging an inspiring path to freedom.

title: Khatta Meetha
desc: Sachin, a contractor, sues the Satara Municipal Corporation for unpaid dues. His ex-girlfriend, now the commissioner, seeks revenge while a bridge collapse and legal troubles escalate his problems.

title: Baby John
desc: DCP Satya Verma fakes his death to shield his daughter from a deadly politician. But when enemies return, he must face his past to protect his family at all costs.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Karz
desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy
desc: 10 years before the Sepoy Mutiny, Emperor Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy fights the British East India Company in order to put an end to their atrocities.

title: Insaaf (1987)
desc: After punishing unruly students, lecturer Avinash finds his life shattered as they viciously retaliate by targeting his family, pushing him to seek justice and confront their cruelty.

title: Kal Aaj Aur Kal
desc: When Rajesh returns to India after completing his higher studies in London, he is urged to marry Rukmani for the sake of an old promise. He finds himself in a dilemma since he is in love with Monica.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Mission Raniganj : The Great Bharat Rescue
desc: Jaswant Singh Gill, a mining engineer, bravely leads a rescue mission to save 65 miners stuck inside a flooded coal mine, risking everything for their lives and safety.

title: Runway 34
desc: Two pilots made a risky landing in Thiruvananthapuram due to bad weather. Trouble begins when aviation authorities investigate the incident, uncovering deeper issues.

title: Kishen Kanhaiya
desc: Twin brothers Kishen and Kanhaiya, separated at birth-one rich, one poor-reunite years later to join forces and battle evil, proving blood ties conquer all odds.
